purpose: Replace the failed simple-momentum breakout baseline with leakage-safe expanding-window age and price cohort priors and blended early-lifecycle signals.
prior_information_rule: Only cases with decision_cutoff strictly before the target cutoff may contribute realized outcomes to a prior.

selection_policy.primary: positive rank correlation and positive top-bottom spread
selection_policy.secondary: maximize 70-percent breakout top-quantile capture and minimize false-negative rate
selection_policy.guardrail: no candidate may be promoted from this tournament without owner review and broader replay evidence
